title: com.ottoyard.depot.arrival.intent (operator to OTTO-Q)
description: A car is coming home: when, with how much charge, what it needs, and when it must be ready. A later intent for the same car (higher intent_version) replaces the earlier one. charge_target_pct is the owner's target and may only come from the owner's credential; without it the owner's contract applies (100% today, CLAUDE.md rule 9). OTTO-Q never lowers it.

eta_spread_s.description: The operator's own uncertainty on eta, one standard deviation, seconds.
